caption: The drawing depicts two views of a cast metal mold, both rendered in shades of grey and blue. The mold is circular in shape with a small handle on one side. In the upper view, the mold is closed, showing a slightly domed top section formed by a number of hemispherical protrusions arranged in a pattern. In the lower view, the mold is open on a hinge, revealing the interior. The bottom half of the mold is a shallow, round cavity with a ridged border, while the top half contains matching hemispherical indentations that align with the protrusions on the exterior. The objects are placed centrally on a plain, off-white background, and the artist's signature, "V. L. Vance," appears to the right of the open mold.
title: Ice Cream Mold
